about: Password: how long your password takes to crack. Factory #11, backlog row 12. Contradiction film built on one object the viewer recognises: P@ssw0rd! ticks every old rule (capital, number, symbol) yet cracks instantly, because it has shown up in data breaches over 100,000 times (Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords count, 119,515 on 2026-10-27) and Hive Systems' 2026 table gives a previously stolen or dictionary-word password 'Instantly' at any length. A random password has to be guessed: Hive's 2026 rig (16 rented RTX 5090s, bcrypt cost 10, offline, random passwords) makes about 139,000 guesses a second (measured 138,675 H/s): 8 random lowercase letters take about 2 weeks, each extra letter multiplies that by 26, 12 letters take about 21,000 years. Six random words from EFF's 7,776-word list (EFF's own recommendation) would take billions of years at that speed (our math: 7,776^6 / 138,675 per second, about 50 billion years for the full search). NIST SP 800-63B-4 (July 2025): at least 15 characters for a password used alone, and no forced mixes of character types; its own example of a predictable password is 'Password1!'. CISA: turn on multifactor authentication, so a stolen password isn't enough. Ends asking: is it on for your email? Yes or no. Defensive only: no tools, commands, wordlists or techniques. Narration-led: the voice is recorded first and every visual beat is keyed to its word times.

lines.text: So how long to crack a password?
It's got a capital, a number, a symbol.
But it's shown up in data breaches over 100,000 times.
lines.say: But it's shown up in data breaches over a hundred thousand times.

lines.text: Leaked passwords get tried first. So, instantly.
Now random ones get guessed, about 139,000 a second.
lines.say: Now random ones get guessed. About a hundred thirty-nine thousand a second.

lines.text: Eight random letters? About two weeks.
Each extra letter multiplies that by 26.
lines.say: Each extra letter multiplies that by twenty-six.
But twelve letters? Twenty-one thousand years.

lines.text: Six random words? Billions of years.
That's why federal guidelines pick length over symbols.
And turn on two-step login, so a stolen password isn't enough.
Is it on for your email? Yes or no.
